name: JEEBench Physics
protocol: JEEBench EMNLP 2023 fixed 123-question Physics slice, vanilla zero-shot, temperature 0, no CoT/few-shot/tools/self-consistency, published partial-credit metric.

explanation.en: Single and integer answers use exact match, numeric answers use 0.01 tolerance, and multi-select answers receive the published partial-credit rule before averaging.
explanation.zh: 单选和整数题严格匹配，数值题允许 0.01 误差，多选题按论文规则给部分分，再对 123 道题取平均。

summary.en: JEEBench Physics measures text-only quantitative reasoning on fixed JEE Advanced physics questions with heterogeneous answer types.
summary.zh: JEEBench Physics 使用固定 JEE Advanced 物理题，测试模型在多种答案类型下的纯文本定量推理能力。

task_format.en: The model solves 123 text-only Physics questions and returns single-choice, multiple-choice, integer, or numeric answers.
task_format.zh: 模型解决 123 道纯文本 Physics 题，并返回单选、多选、整数或数值答案。
